meta.title: Business Process (Manufacturing Cloud)
meta.description: Golden reference for the map-process-from-data-model skill: the hand-made Manufacturing Cloud process map on WG3, transcribed level by level on 18 October 2026. Box text, roles, objects and the labels of lines inside a level are verbatim, defects included (see gaps). Each child level's start and end labels are set to its box's lines on the top level, so the drill-downs match. Supporting processes on the top level: Manage Fleets of Assets; Create and manage manufacturing programs.
meta.author: golden fixture, transcribed from the WG3 exemplar map

sources.note: Data Model Gallery, Manufacturing category: one guide per capability
Manufacturing Cloud developer guide: standard objects and their API names

attachments.title: Objects used
attachments.text:
Objects Used:
Product: Stores information about each product, such as model, part type, and commercial value.
Catalog: Groups products into collections for easier management.
Category: Organizes products within catalogs into logical groups and subgroups.
